How service jobs work

Small tweaks & bigger work

A few small tweaks, a typo, a phone number, a photo swap, are straightforward to request. Bigger work, like a new page or a new feature, is quoted up front before anything starts, so you approve the price first.

Available for hire

Fixes, updates & new features

Quoted per job

Need something fixed, updated, or added? Fixes, updates, and adding new features are all available for hire. Each job is quoted on its own, no work begins until you have approved the quote.

Ongoing, on request

Management retainer

Ask for a quote

If you would rather we run it, Protiva can manage the site for you. The retainer is available on request and priced after a short audit of your setup. It covers up to 4 content updates a month, priority support, and a short monthly report. You can cancel any time.

Not sure which you need? Use the builder yourself for day-to-day changes in plain words. Hire Protiva here when you want the work done for you.

Questions first? Call Dang at Protiva on 647-281-3656 or email dang@protiva.dev, but you don’t need a call to buy. The button above is the whole process.

The full proposal

Hosting, handoff, monthly costs, ownership and the fine print, for when you want every detail.

How payment works

50% to start, 25% as the work takes shape, and the final 25% on completion. Clinic treatment pricing is confirmed at consultation.

What gets finished before launch

Your verified menu, phone booking, directions, FAQ and brand are brought together on one website. The consultation form and assistant shown here are previews; delivery and live responses are configured and tested before launch.

Photos and stand-ins

The demo uses clearly labeled stand-ins, not evidence of clinic results. Before launch, your real before & after photos take their place. Patient consent and permission to publish must be confirmed.

Five questions for the clinic

  • Is the cosmetics arm still taking new clients?
  • What are the prices for the Venus Versa treatments and lip fillers?
  • What are your confirmed hours?
  • Can you supply real patient reviews with permission to publish?
  • Can you supply real before/after photos with permission to publish?

Hosting and complete handoff

Complete handoff $40 CAD/month, subject to change, includes hosted services and the AI-assisted builder with limited usage. Additional usage, domain renewal, email and other provider fees are passed through at cost and explained before setup.

Your domain and email

A suitable domain can be registered in your name. Keep your current email or discuss a domain mailbox; renewal and mailbox costs are confirmed before setup.

Ownership

You own the website, content and files. At handoff you receive access and the information needed to manage or move the site.

Getting found: Google and AI answers

SEO, AEO and GEO work starts with clear treatment information, accessible pages and consistent verified business details. Search placement is not guaranteed.

Business System: discovery before implementation

We audit your enquiry process, then agree the CRM scope, enquiry stages, access permissions, data export and any follow-up features before implementation. Booking remains by phone unless a new process is confirmed with the clinic.

Services and support

Fixes, updates and new features are quoted per job. An optional management retainer is quoted after a setup audit and includes up to 4 content updates per month; additional work is quoted in advance.
